I'm applying for the Marketing Automation Consultant role at your Genk hub.

My background sits where marketing and code meet: I build and optimize websites with HTML, CSS and JavaScript, use JSON-LD structured data and llms.txt to make content machine-readable, and connect WordPress and SEO tools through MCP and API integrations. I'd welcome a conversation.

cover_letter:
Dear hiring team at Dignify,

I'm writing to apply for the Marketing Automation Consultant position at your Genk hub. Marketing automation is where the two halves of my working life meet: the technical side — HTML, CSS, JavaScript, APIs, structured data — and the marketing side — content, search and measurement.

At Episto I handle on-page SEO, keyword research and content for client sites in consultancy and e-commerce, working in WordPress with Elementor, Astra and Rank Math. Alongside that I run my own freelance practice, where I build sites end to end. For mirook.com I implemented JSON-LD schema, knowledge-graph markup and an llms.txt file, then ran iterative technical audits against them. For a pharmacists' association I built a WordPress site with a consistent layout across roughly 600 member profile pages — templated, data-driven publishing that is close to the ground marketing automation stands on.

My earlier work was more directly technical. At Knowledge Experts I helped build SharePoint-based digital workplaces for ŞOK Market, 4,000+ stores with ERP/POS integration, and for Aras Kargo. Before that, at ViviDoctor in Belgium, I developed and optimized front-end features for a healthcare web application in AngularJS and JavaScript. Today I connect WordPress and SEO tools through MCP integrations, and use Python and LLMs to automate the repetitive parts of the work.

I want to be straight with you about the platform requirement: I haven't worked hands-on with Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Bloomreach, Selligent or Braze yet. What I bring instead is a working foundation — markup, scripting, APIs, data flows and structured content — plus a genuine appetite for the training and certification you offer. Learning these platforms from your specialists, on projects for retail, publishing, travel and healthcare clients, is exactly the environment I'm looking for.

I'd be glad to talk about how I could contribute.

Kind regards,
Baver Ok

baverok@gmail.com

cv_highlights:

APIs and integrations: MCP integrations connecting WordPress and SEO tooling; SharePoint-based digital workplaces for ŞOK Market (4,000+ stores, ERP/POS integration) and Aras Kargo
Automation and scripting: Python automation and daily LLM use to remove repetitive work from research, content and audits; an Android app live on Google Play
Structured data and dynamic content: JSON-LD schema (Person, SportsEvent, FAQPage), knowledge-graph markup, llms.txt and entity optimization; templated, consistent publishing across ~600 member profile pages
Analytics, certifications and growth: Google Analytics, Search Console, Semrush, Ahrefs, Google Ads; Semrush SEO Fundamentals and SEO Toolkit, HubSpot Content Marketing; eager to train and certify on Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Bloomreach, Selligent and Braze
